description.en:
From Sherbet Lemon:  
  
Hui-Dong, a high school girl who wanted to diet so badly because Dai-Xi always tease her about it. But Dai-Xi just teases her because he likes her and he never thought she would take it seriously. Hui-Dong took many kinds of diet pills but none of them worked. So she ate this kind of pill that is so strong that it was against the law to eat them. And because of extreme running and the pills, she died of weak heart. But somehow her soul never went to heaven, instead she stayed in the living world. Until she met an angel that put her soul into Dai-Xi's doll. But Dai-Xi soon found out about it and he…

Adhering to the motto of "Satisfaction is always happy", Su Buqi, the bastard of the demon family, has a genius brother who wants to get rid of him and then hurry up, and a demon sister who is playing black hands everywhere. In a large-scale encirclement and suppression activity in the Demon Realm, he was thrown away as cannon fodder and was thrown to the front line to meet a beautiful girl who claimed to be Daji, and Su Buqi's dream of a flat and stable life was messed up. Times are different, the monsters have changed their careers to do responsive firms, welcome to the League of Monster Loser!

This series relates the camaraderie and heart-stopping exploits of the Celestians, extraordinary people who live during the tumultuous Warring States Era. Living in a world of their own - a place known as the 'Celestial Zone' - they cultivate special powers beyond the comprehension of mere mortals. Unfortunately, some of them branch into the cultivation of the evil power of corruption, bringing destruction and sorrow to the mortal world. The series centres around the war that starts between the Celestians.

Provence is a popular cafe that is owned by brother and sister, Hayes and Hayumi. Many young girls come to Provence just to meet Hayes. In the first story we meet Yune who is a high school student who illustrates childrens books, who is enamored of Hayes. Will she be able to confess how she feels?  
  
In the second arc we switch to Hayumi and Alan. Alan has been in love with Hayumi for a long time, however is constantly rejected by her. Will he finally win her over?

description.en:
The mysterious holographic game “Endless Firmament” takes the world by storm. Li Fan, the ultimate tank player, meets a tragic end after being backstabbed by his trusted brother and girlfriend. However, he suddenly regresses ten years into the past, right to the exact moment the game first launched.

Starting fresh, Li Fan obtains the SSS-rank talent “Blessing of Light,” which permanently increases his agility whenever he hunts monsters. He also unlocks the hidden class of Shield-Armor Warrior, transforming himself into the fastest tank alive. Speeding through the levels, Li Fan sets his sights on a single goal: to conquer the game at lightning speed and stand atop the world as the ultimate peak warrior.
description.pt-br:
O misterioso jogo holográfico “Firmamento Infinito” toma o mundo de assalto. Li Fan, o jogador de tanque supremo, encontra um fim trágico após ser traído pelas costas por seu irmão de confiança e sua namorada. No entanto, ele repentinamente regride dez anos ao passado, exatamente no momento em que o jogo é lançado pela primeira vez.

Começando novamente do zero, Li Fan obtém o talento de Rank SSS “Bênção da Luz”, que aumenta permanentemente sua agilidade sempre que ele caça monstros. Ele também desbloqueia a classe oculta de Guerreiro de Armadura e Escudo, transformando-se no tanque mais rápido de todos. Avançando pelos níveis em uma velocidade vertiginosa, Li Fan estabelece um único objetivo: conquistar o jogo em uma velocidade relâmpago e alcançar o topo do mundo como o guerreiro supremo.

description.en:
An anthology of stories of characters from the Eastern Zhou (770-256 BC) from various states who left their marks in history.  
Some were successful and some failed in their endeavors but all achieved fame, if not notoriety.

"Wedding Theme" is a historical romance, the setting is same as that of the "Romance of The Three Kingdoms." This manga creates a entirely different image of Zhou Yu who is portrayed more as a bad guy in "Romance of The Three Kingdoms." But, Zhou Yu is dashing, handsome, and young when he meets the heroine of this manga…

Only 4 hours after being dumped by the money-worshiping girlfriend, I became a murderer?! I thought I had erased all the evidence, yet the police still showed up… NO! For my mother on her sickbed and my bright future that yet to come, I can not get caught!!

After an embarrassing encounter, Fei Yuan would like nothing more than to escape Fu Zhaoshui. But Fu Zhaoshui is relentless, and he will do anything to keep Fei Yuan within his clutches. The two men engage in an elaborate game of cat and mouse, with passionate love nudging them along

University student Yan Fu who lives outside the dormitory has a neighbour, Liu Zi Ning, who is a single dad. Liu Zi Ning doesn’t know how to take care of a baby, but Yan Fu knows how to, the two people and baby became a warm “family of three”. When Yan Fu’s feelings towards Liu Zi Ning are increasing everyday, Liu Zi Ning is having thoughts of having a girlfriend.
description.zh: 外宿的大学生严福的邻居刘梓宁是个单身爸爸。刘梓宁对照顾婴儿感到无措，严福却对此得心应手，两个人跟一个孩子组成了温馨的“一家三口”。在严福对刘梓宁的感情日益热烈的时候，刘梓宁却起了找女友的心思。

description.en: Dragon Ball Centuries is a fan manga by Karoine that stars Goku Jr. after his World Tournament match against Vegeta Jr. at the end of Dragon Ball GT, it shows him facing a new threat to the Earth.

The story begins when Hui-Sheng, a seemingly ordinary high school girl, receives a deck of angel cards from a mysterious stranger, Jason. With the angel cards, Hui-Sheng attempts to find out who her guardian angel is. But the result of the reading (a blank card) shows that she has none…

altTitles.fr: Le méchant veut juste se la couler douce

description.fr:
Ye Zexi a été transmigré en tant que grand méchant dans un roman danmei, portant le même nom que lui. Puis, il découvre que tout le monde le considère comme un ennemi imaginaire.

À cet égard, il ne suit qu’un seul principe : Ne pas vouloir se battre, prendre tout ce que vous voulez.

Dans l’émission d’audition du groupe de garçons :
Un membre de l’équipe voulait prendre la position de C [Centre] à Ye Zexi.
Ye Zexi a pris l’initiative de se retirer pour être paresseux.
Le membre de l’équipe était complaisant et pensait que Ye Zexi avait le trac et le membre de l’équipe était déterminé à gagner.
Après la performance, Ye Zexi a pris la première place.
Membre de l’équipe : ?

L’instructeur a demandé à tout le monde quel était leur but pour participer à la compétition.
Autres concurrents : Les rêves, parce que nous aimons la scène !
Ye Zexi : Pour rentrer chez moi et hériter de la propriété familiale.
Autres concurrents : ???

À sa grande surprise, non seulement Ye Zexi n’a pas réussi à être paresseux, mais il est aussi devenu plus populaire.

description.en: Prepare for cuteness overload with Su Mianmian, a three-and-a-half-year-old metaphysics wonder! Cradling her milk bottle, she’s a fortune-telling sensation, adored by the nation’s wealthiest family. Whether she’s exposing scandals live on air, banishing evil, or revealing hidden fates, she’s a force to be reckoned with. Villains beware: one flick of her wrist and a well-placed talisman will put you in your place! This pint-sized powerhouse, with a thousand years of cultivation, dishes out epic comebacks and spreads joy. The internet is obsessed, demanding new chapters: “The ultimate adorable badass? Sign me up!*From the author of my previous work, “Matriarch Downgraded into a Mistress”
